sloka: न त्वं रामस्य सदृशो दास्ये ऽप्यस्य न युज्यसे ।यज्ञीयः सत्यवादी च रणश्लाघी च राघवः ।। ५.५८.७२ ।।।।
transliteration: na tvaṁ rāmasya sadṛśo dāsye 'pyasya na yujyase ।yajñīyaḥ satyavādī ca raṇaślāghī ca rāghavaḥ ।। 5.58.72 ।।।।

translations.english: 'You are not equal to Rama and not even fit to be his servant. He does yagnas and always abides in truth. He is valiant in war.
